questions.question: When Joab heard that Abner had visited King David and left in peace, what did Joab do?

answers.text: Demanded to know why David let Abner go
Thanked David for making peace with Abner
Handed David the plunder from the raid

questions.question: Joab and his brother Abishai murdered Abner to avenge their brother Asahel. Where had Abner killed Asahel?
After Joab murdered Abner, King David asked the LORD to forgive Joab and his father's house. True or false?
After Joab murdered Abner, what did King David order Joab and all the people with him to do?

answers.text: Tear their clothes and mourn Abner
